title: Great sturdy molds..
text: Great sturdy molds... These are a nice size. I thought they would be small but they are a nice cupcake size. The face details are indented nicely in the mold so that when you take the cake out of the mold, you can see the raised face features! That makes decorating these so much easier. So many possibilities...jello, ice cubes, maybe even with rice crispies!!

product_metadata.title: Wilton Ghost Non-Stick Silicone Mold, 6-Cavity
features: Making ghost-shaped treats for Halloween or any spooky occasion is easy with this silicone pan
Silicone bakeware is flexible and non-stick so treats pop right out of the mold
This silicone bakeware is heat resistant up to 375 degrees F; freezer, microwave and oven safe
Dishwasher safe or wash in warm, soapy water before first and after each use
description: This non-stick silicone mold lets you make all kinds of ghost-shaped treats like brownies, mini cakes or molded candies. Perfect for adding spooky fun to your dessert table this Halloween. This silicone baking mold is also great to make individual treats to hand out as party favors when you wrap them in cute gift bags with bows (not included).
